_note: Per-assistant connection values. Fill with VERIFIED values only — never guess server addresses, directory listings, install links or auth methods. null / [] = not verified yet: shown as a launch dependency in preview, and the production build fails.

_fields.connectionUrl: Where this assistant's 'Connect to …' button goes inside the setup card (direct install / connector page).
_fields.heroCtaTarget: setup = page CTAs open this assistant's setup card (default). connection = page CTAs go straight to connectionUrl.
_fields.serverUrl: Optional MCP server address users paste during manual setup (shown with a copy button).
_fields.accountRequirements: Which Claude / ChatGPT account or plan is required (text).
_fields.restrictions: Known restrictions, or 'None known' once verified (text).
_fields.firstPromptId: Prompt id from prompts.json shown as the first prompt.
